description: This file defines a data source class 'EntitiesDataSource' for managing and fetching entities with support for selection, pagination, and reactive updates, used within an Angular application.

classes.name: EntitiesDataSource
classes.description: A data source class for managing a collection of entities with support for loading, selection, and reactive state management.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Returns an observable of the entities array for collection viewer.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Completes the subject streams to clean up resources.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the data source to an empty state and triggers data loaded callback.

methods.name: loadEntities
methods.description: Loads entities based on a page link, manages subscriptions, and updates internal state.

methods.name: onEntities
methods.description: Updates the entities subject with a new list of entities.

methods.name: isAllSelected
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating whether all selectable entities are selected.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating whether the entities list is empty.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns an observable of total number of entities.

methods.name: toggleCurrentEntity
methods.description: Sets the specified entity as current if different from the current one.

methods.name: isCurrentEntity
methods.description: Checks if the given entity is the current entity.

methods.name: masterToggle
methods.description: Selects or clears all entities based on current selection state.

methods.name: selectableEntitiesCount
methods.description: Counts entities that are enabled for selection.
